summary: Callback tips: edit the example script for smarter failure handling, set a 1-2 minute inventory cache timeout with Update On Launch for cloud inventories, run at first boot rather than from cron (if cron, every 30 minutes); a host not found in inventory gets a No Hosts Matched failure.
questions: Why does my provisioning callback fail with No Hosts Matched?
How often should I run the callback script from cron?
What inventory cache timeout should I use with callbacks?
Is running callbacks at first boot recommended?
